description: Clean full-file pass: CBACT01C opens ACCTFILE, reads all 50 account records sequentially, displays each one and closes, ending with RETURN-CODE 0. app/cbl/CBACT01C.cbl:L70-L87 displays every record TWICE - 1100-DISPLAY-ACCT-RECORD is performed from inside the '00' arm of the read paragraph at L96, so its eleven labelled field lines (L119-L129) and 49-hyphen separator (L130) precede the mainline's raw DISPLAY ACCOUNT-RECORD at L78 - giving 13 lines per record and 1 + (50 x 13) + 1 = 652 lines in all. Two further legacy oddities are preserved rather than tidied: ACCT-ADDR-ZIP is in the record but is never displayed, and ACCT-GROUP-ID is blank in all 50 rows so its line ends in ten spaces. R1 caveat: the mandated name AccountBalanceJob performs no balance work whatsoever - the source Function header reads 'Read and print account data file' - and this case pins that by asserting all 50 rows unchanged on the final-state channel while expectedWrites is empty. Record layout, taken mechanically from app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy as thirteen absolute zero-based spans over 300 bytes (practice B11): ACCT-ID 0/11, ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS 11/1, ACCT-CURR-BAL 12/12, ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT 24/12, ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT 36/12, ACCT-OPEN-DATE 48/10, ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE 58/10 (the copybook's own misspelling, preserved per I1), ACCT-REISSUE-DATE 68/10, ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT 78/12, ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT 90/12, ACCT-ADDR-ZIP 102/10, ACCT-GROUP-ID 112/10, FILLER 122/178 - summing to exactly 300. A PIC S9(10)V99 field occupies 12 bytes and not 13: it is zoned DISPLAY with the sign overpunched into the trailing byte, which is why every monetary value here ends in '{' - the positive-zero overpunch, a correct byte rather than corrupt data, and never to be normalised to '0'. The fixture bytes are US-ASCII (practice B8); acctdata.txt matches its copybook width exactly, so this case declares no normalisation. Baseline provenance (practice B12): these expected values are STATICALLY DERIVED from the COBOL source, the copybook byte layout, the READACCT.jcl STEP05 DD contract - which declares no PARM, hence no job parameter - and the real 50-row ASCII fixture. They were NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution: running the legacy programs is empirically impossible in this environment, as AAP section 0.7.6 establishes with eight independently verified blockers, and the substitution of provenance is escalated as risk R-A rather than absorbed silently. Gates discharged: G15 (one of the twenty cases this program owns), G18 (the diff count must be zero), G19 (the 300-byte account record width), G21 (FILLER present and space-filled - every raw line is 300 bytes with 122-299 all spaces), G47 (the '00' open, the fifty '00' reads and the '10' end-of-file on the fifty-first, which is a normal boundary and not an error) and G51 (the job is driven at tasklet level with no JobLauncher and no HTTP layer in the path).
